let Column := Nat → Bool
let Gate := Bool × Nat × Nat
let wire (s : List Column) (i : Nat) := s.getD i (fun _ => false)
let mix (op : Bool) (x y : Column) : Column := fun r => if op then x r && y r else x r || y r
let newWire (s : List Column) (g : Gate) := mix g.1 (wire s g.2.1) (wire s g.2.2)
let step (s : List Column) (g : Gate) := s ++ [newWire s g]
let charge (t : Nat) (s : List Column) (g : Gate) := (!g.1 && !(newWire s g t)).toNat
let cost (t : Nat) (s : List Column) (gs : List Gate) : Nat :=
  (gs.foldl (fun z g => (step z.1 g,z.2 + charge t z.1 g)) (s,0)).2
let extend (x : Nat) : Nat :=
  let b (i : Nat) := (x >>> i) &&& 1
  x ||| ((b 0 ||| b 1) <<< 26) ||| ((b 3 ||| b 9) <<< 27)
let pos (i : Nat) := extend (positive[i]!)
let neg (i : Nat) := extend (negative[i]!)
let input (j : Nat) : Column := fun r =>
  (if r < 52 then pos r else neg (r-52)).testBit j
let base (i : Fin 30) : Column :=
  if i.val < 28 then input i.val
  else if i.val = 28 then mix true (input 15) (input 27)
  else mix true (input 17) (input 26)
let fixed (k : Fin 32) : Column :=
  if h : k.val < 30 then base ⟨k.val,h⟩
  else if k.val = 30 then mix true (input 13) (input 26) else mix true (input 13) (input 27)
let initial := ([(true,1,24),(true,15,32),(true,25,32),(true,0,17),(true,0,23),(true,0,25)] : List (Bool × Nat × Nat)).foldl step (step (List.ofFn fixed) (false,2,6))
let rows : Array (Fin 468) := #[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 33, 34, 35, 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 46, 48, 49, 51, 53, 55, 59, 62, 63, 64, 68, 69, 70, 71, 73, 75, 76, 78, 83, 86, 88, 91, 95, 98, 99, 101, 102, 103, 104, 111, 112, 113, 115, 121, 123, 125, 126, 127, 133, 135, 138, 139, 140, 141, 142, 143, 146, 148, 153, 156, 158, 159, 161, 162, 163, 164, 166, 167, 170, 173, 175, 176, 178, 180, 181, 185, 187, 188, 190, 192, 193, 195, 196, 197, 198, 200, 204, 208, 211, 213, 214, 218, 221, 224, 226, 229, 232, 233, 234, 239, 241, 243, 244, 245, 246, 250, 251, 254, 257, 258, 260, 262, 263, 268, 270, 272, 273, 275, 278, 280, 281, 282, 283, 285, 287, 288, 294, 296, 298, 299, 300, 303, 306, 311, 314, 316, 318, 320, 321, 325, 328, 329, 333, 337, 342, 343, 344, 347, 348, 349, 350, 352, 353, 360, 363, 364, 366, 367, 368, 370, 371, 374, 375, 377, 378, 379, 384, 385, 387, 392, 397, 400, 402, 407, 410, 413, 415, 418, 419, 420, 421, 422, 423, 424, 425, 426, 427, 432, 435, 439, 441, 442, 445, 446, 448, 454, 458, 463]
let orWires (s : List Column) (gs : List Gate) : List Column :=
  gs.foldr (fun g next state =>
    let rest := next (step state g)
    if g.1 then rest else newWire state g :: rest) (fun _ => []) s
∀ (gs : List Gate) (o : Nat),
    (∀ p : Fin 52, wire (gs.foldl step initial) o p.val = true) →
    (∀ j : Fin 468, wire (gs.foldl step initial) o (52+j.val) = false) →
    let ws := orWires initial gs
    ∀ (port : Fin 2 × Fin 8 → Fin ws.length) (words : Fin 2 → Fin 218 → Fin 256),
    Function.Injective port → (∀ b, Function.Injective (words b)) →
    (∀ b i k, (words b k).val.testBit i.val = ws[(port (b,i)).val] (52+(rows[k.val]!).val)) →
    24 ≤ ws.length
